svg.title: Enterprise Voice Agent Multi-Party Streaming Diarization & Speaker Role Privilege Isolation (Stage 370 · P733–P734)
svg.desc: Visual comparison of legacy single-channel mixed-mono speaker splicing vs P733 overlap-aware streaming diarization (<=320ms window) and P734 speaker-role privilege fence with bystander write lock.
svg.text: STAGE 370 · TOPIC 10 · P733–P734
Multi-Party Streaming Diarization & Speaker-Role Write Privilege Isolation
多人同场免提与三方通话防越权：流式重叠语音分离归因 (P733) 与主叫声纹角色写权限锁 + 旁人建议主叫复核 (P734)
① P733: Overlap-Aware Streaming Diarization (<=320ms Frame Attribution)
⛔ Legacy Mixed-Mono ASR (Frankenstein Sentence Splicing)
• Caller (Speaker 1): "Transfer $500 to my savings..."
• Bystander / Roommate (Speaker 2 chimes in): "...make it $5,000 to account 8899!"
• Legacy ASR merges both voices into one string -> LLM executes unauthorized $5,000 wire!
Industry Baseline: >31% DER degradation on overlapping speech with naive VAD+Clustering (anonymized_reported)
✅ P733: Hybrid Channel Split + EEND Overlap-Aware Diarization
1. Tiered Channel Selection: Use SIP Stereo / Multi-Mic Beamforming when physically
available; enforce EEND + d-Vector streaming diarization on single-mic speakerphone
2. Sub-Second Frame Window (<=320ms): Sliding frame-level multi-label classification
detects simultaneous speech (S1 + S2 active) instead of waiting for silence gaps
3. Structured Speaker XML Tagging: Every token injected into LLM carries
<speaker id="S1" role="verified_primary" sim="0.91"> vs <speaker id="S2" role="bystander">
P733 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
② P734: Speaker-Role RBAC Fence & Primary Caller Re-Confirmation Lock
Diarization Architecture Selection Matrix
• Path A: Dual-Channel SIPREC / Multi-Mic Beamforming — 0ms extra DSP lag, 100% channel split
• Path B: Streaming EEND + d-Vector Role Lock (P733+P734 Recommended for PSTN/Mobile)
<=320ms frame window, isolates mobile speakerphone bystanders & 3-way conference legs
• Path C: Post-Call Batch Diarization (Azure Fast Transcription RTF=0.057)
Ideal for offline QA / compliance analytics; cannot block mid-call bystander tool hijacks
✅ P734: Three-Tier Speaker RBAC & Zero-Overlap Write Gate
• Role Tiering: verified_primary (Full R/W) vs authorized_advisor (Read/Draft) vs
unverified_bystander (Context-Only; 0% direct tool mutation or PII readout privilege)
• Hard Write Pre-Condition: Require primarySpeakerCosineSim >= 0.82 AND
activeOverlapRatio <= 0.05 before committing any payment, booking, or address change
• Bystander Slot Quarantine: Hold bystander-suggested parameters until Primary confirms
P734 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
PROVENANCE & MEASUREMENT BOUNDARY DISCLOSURE (STAGE 370 · DIMENSION 373)
• Offline Policy State Machine (P733/P734): 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution; actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic).
• Live Acoustic Diarization DSP: Real-time EEND/d-Vector inference latency is not_measured in local policy tests; offline Azure Fast Transcription PoC measured at RTF=0.057 (measured).
